title: Distance · noun
subtitle: 「距離／間距／分隔／範圍／跨度」，究竟是哪一種 distance？
description: 「距離／間距／分隔／範圍／跨度」，究竟是哪一種 distance？

words.note: 使用者提供。這是 distance 最直接、最透明的解釋性改寫，強調兩個人、物體或地點之間實際存在的空間。它適合教學、定義與一般描述，但不是固定的單字同義詞。
words.example: Leave enough space between the chairs.

exercises.original: The distance between the two desks should be at least one metre.
exercises.zh: 兩張書桌之間的間距至少應有一米。
exercises.upgrade: space between · 兩者之間的空間；間距

options.explanation: between the two desks + measurable spacing directly describes literal space between objects.
常與 platform/train, door/frame, competitors 等可見空隙或差距搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 measurable physical spacing between two objects；這裡需要的是「兩者之間的實際空間」。因此 gap 雖然都與距離有關，但測量對象、空間結構、功能性或是否強調偏遠狀態並不最吻合。
常與 communities, people, regions, barriers 等『彼此分開』語境搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 measurable physical spacing between two objects；這裡需要的是「兩者之間的實際空間」。因此 separation 雖然都與距離有關，但測量對象、空間結構、功能性或是否強調偏遠狀態並不最吻合。

words.note: 較窄。當 distance 指一條道路、路線、賽道、行程或線段從起點到終點的總長度時，length 很自然。它強調 measured extent along something。
words.example: The length of the route is twelve kilometres.

exercises.zh: 步行路線全長八公里。

falseSynonyms.zh: space 很廣，可表示空間本身；distance 通常是兩點之間可比較／可測量的間距。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There is plenty of space in the room. The distance between the towns is twenty kilometres.

falseSynonyms.zh: gap 強調明確空隙或差距；不是所有兩地之間的 distance 都自然叫 gap。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Mind the gap between the train and the platform. The distance between the cities is 200 kilometres.

falseSynonyms.zh: range 通常表示最大有效可達距離；一般兩點間距不叫 range。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The radio has a ten-kilometre range. The distance between the houses is fifty metres.

falseSynonyms.zh: interval 常表示重複、規律的間隔；任意兩點距離未必是 interval。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Trees were planted at five-metre intervals. The distance from the station to the hotel is one kilometre.

falseSynonyms.zh: length 是某物由一端到另一端的長度；distance 可以是兩個獨立地點之間的空間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The tunnel has a length of two kilometres. The distance between the tunnel and the station is two kilometres.

falseSynonyms.zh: remoteness 只表示偏遠程度，不提供精確公里數。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The remoteness of the island makes travel difficult. The distance to the mainland is forty kilometres.

falseSynonyms.zh: separation 強調彼此分開的狀態；distance 更容易表示可量度空間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Years apart created emotional separation. The distance between their houses is ten kilometres.

falseSynonyms.zh: distance 是名詞；distant 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The distance is considerable. The village is distant from the capital.
